Faran_About: Muhammad Faran Aiki (April 8, 2007) is currently a university student in School of Electrical Engineering and Informatics - Computation (SEEI-C), Bandung Institute of Technology. He is an intern at Analitica as the Education Team starting at May 2025 and a Flutter software engineer front-end (Technology Team) programmer starting at October 2025. Moreover, he is a certified-proven human anomaly.
Faran_Philosophy: The name Faran Aiki comes from the word Faran "advance", while the name Aiki comes from the Japanese words "ai" (愛) and "ki" (気) which mean 'the energy of love'. Thus, "Faran Aiki" means '(one who) loves advancement and progress'.
Faran_Principle: To vow to love, give meaning to, uphold, and glorify (1) God, (2) Knowledge and Wisdom, and (3) The Passion for Advancement and Progress. With these principles as a standard and benchmark to carry on with life, he has a foundation and basis not to give up in continuing through hard days. Although sometimes deviating from the principles above, he never forgets to return to this path that has brought him this far because, fundamentally, humans cannot be perfect, but they can strive to hold fast to what guides their life.
Faran_Vision_Mission: To be a person who continuously grows and develops, and is able to encourage progress—be it physical, mental, or intellectual—collectively and holistically, based on love and affection driven by rationality and empathy. With this vision, he strives to learn relentlessly, such as studying science, technology, and social-humanities, as well as reflecting through his own experiences or those of others to create innovative solutions for existing problems. Furthermore, he also prioritizes the values of goodness that are widely, globally, and rationally accepted. He does this to prove the worthiness of his name's meaning, which is to advance and progress, both individually and as a group.
